events.verdict: Collins (CHI) steps forward prior to marginal body contact occurring with Barnes (TOR) during Barnes' upward shooting motion.
Mogbo (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Giddey (CHI) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the rebound.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Mogbo (TOR) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Chicago.
Dick (TOR) is turning slightly prior to marginal side-to-side body contact occurring with Giddey (CHI).
Collins (CHI) establishes a screening position in Dick's (TOR) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Dick (TOR) is jumping forward as he defends the pass and marginal body contact occurs as Collins (CHI) gains control of the ball.
White (CHI) is moving alongside Dick's (TOR) path and marginal body contact occurs as the two come together at the end of the drive.
White (CHI) contests the jump shot attempt and marginal contact occurs as a result of Dick (TOR) slightly extending his right leg forward toward White.
Barnes (TOR) turns into Giddey (CHI) and initiates body contact that affects Giddey's driving shot attempt.
Huerter (CHI) steps forward and the body contact that occurs with Barrett (TOR) after his gather is marginal.
White (CHI) goes to, not through, Dick's (TOR) space and the contact as the two come together at the top of the perimeter is marginal.
Barrett (TOR) gathers the rebound while in the air, returns to the floor, and takes more than two steps without releasing the ball.
Quickley (TOR) turns toward Giddey (CHI) and marginal body contact occurs during Giddey's driving shot attempt.
Huerter (CHI) brushes Barrett's (TOR) front and right arm as he elevates to pass and the contact is marginal.
Collins (CHI) and Mogbo (TOR) make incidental foot contact with one another after the release of the shot attempt.
White (CHI) initiates contact across Barnes' (TOR) right arm and affects his ability to secure the loose ball.
Giddey (CHI) commits a take foul on Dick (TOR).
Quickley (TOR) closes out into White's (CHI) space and initiates body contact as White is airborne during the jump shot attempt.
Ball (CHI) legally contests Barnes' (TOR) jump shot attempt.
